description: This file contains classes and functions for creating and managing polygons on a Google Map, including drawing, editing, and color management of polygons and their components.

classes.name: PolygonCreator
classes.description: Main class to create and manage polygon drawing on the map.

classes.name: Pen
classes.description: Handles drawing dots, lines, and polygons on the map.

classes.name: Dot
classes.description: Represents a point (dot) on the map with a marker.

classes.name: Polygon
classes.description: Represents a polygon shape with editable properties.

classes.name: Info
classes.description: Provides an info window for editing polygon properties such as color.

methods.name: PolygonCreator
methods.description: Constructor for the main polygon creator class.

methods.name: Pen
methods.description: Constructor for the drawing pen class.

methods.name: Dot
methods.description: Constructor for a dot (point) on the map.

methods.name: Line
methods.description: Constructor for a line connecting dots.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Constructor for the info window associated with polygons.
